reason: Thirty-six dollars for a lip balm is too much on what I live on, and I already have a drawer of lipsticks I wore once. I'm not going to gamble that on a brand nobody has reviewed yet, for me or as a gift.
objection: Will that pink even suit my skin, or my sister's? I've been told 'it works with your natural color' before and it never did. And chasing a refund by mail from a little website I found on Facebook is more bother than I want.
would_change_my_mind: A small trial size around ten dollars, or my daughter or a friend telling me she uses it and it really doesn't dry out or bleed into the lines.
